hero.description: Nyaya AI detects, measures and explains bias in your datasets and model outputs — so the systems you ship are fair, accountable, and ready for the real world.

features.title: Everything you need to audit, explain and ship fair AI
features.biasDetectionBody: Scan datasets and model outputs for hidden patterns of unfairness across protected attributes.
features.fairnessScoreBody: A clear 0–100 metric so anyone — engineer, PM, regulator — knows where you stand.
features.visualsBody: Dashboards and charts that make disparate impact, parity gaps and group rates obvious.
features.plainEnglishBody: We explain why bias appears, in human language — no statistics PhD required.
features.comparisonBody: Pit GPT, Gemini, Claude and your own models side-by-side to see who is fairest.
features.attributeDetectionBody: Auto-identify gender, age, region, caste and other features driving the gap.
features.suggestionsBody: Concrete next steps — reweighting, sampling, prompt fixes — to reduce bias measurably.
features.apiBody: Drop a single endpoint into your stack to bias-check every prediction at request time.
features.auditBody: Export board-ready PDFs with executive summaries, technical depth, and stakeholder-friendly visuals.

why.title: Why teams choose Nyaya
why.subtitle: We built Nyaya because bias has costs.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From dataset to fair decision in four steps.
how.step1Body: Upload a CSV dataset, paste model outputs, or connect via our API. Nyaya AI works with anything from a hiring spreadsheet to GPT-class responses.
how.step2Body: We identify protected features (gender, age, region, caste, etc.) and the columns that drive decisions — no manual labelling needed.
how.step3Body: Get a Fairness Score (0–100), interactive charts, and plain-English explanations of where bias lives — and why.
how.step4Body: Receive concrete remediation steps, export a PDF audit report, and plug a real-time check into your stack.
